Name: Clear the Kobold Lair
Description: The warden needs both kobold groups in Cave A cleared. Defeat the entrance guards and the store-room guards in either order, then return to the Keep for payment.

Stages.Description: Speak to the warden, or continue clearing the two kobold groups in Cave A.
Clear both kobold groups in Cave A: northern entrance chamber and eastern store room.
Both groups are cleared. Return to the warden in the Keep to collect your reward.
The entrance is clear and the warden has rewarded you.

Objectives.Description: Defeat the four entrance guards in the northern chamber.
Defeat the four store-room guards in the eastern chamber.
